versions.changelog:
Initial release of the Dynamix Solana Trading Dashboard skill.

- Guides users through purchasing, activating, and accessing the Dynamix trading platform.
- Explains how to manage Solana wallets, including generating and importing wallets securely.
- Provides detailed steps for configuring trading parameters, entry/exit strategies, and bot operation.
- Covers live trade monitoring, transaction history, portfolio tracking, and account management functions.
- Includes information on platform plans, payments (via Solana), and an exclusive promo code for 15% off.
